Direct GitHub Auto-Sync Setup

Configure your GitHub repository details and Personal Access Token (PAT) below. When you publish or delete pictures, originals are added/removed in images/owner-uploads and index.html is committed to the repository. GitHub Pages/Cloudflare Pages then deploys the change.

Security: This direct-browser method stores your PAT in this browser’s local storage. Use a fine-grained token limited to this one repository with Contents read/write permission, never share this file with the token inside it, and revoke the token if exposed. A private Cloudflare Worker is safer for a public site.

Download Updated Website File:

If GitHub API sync is not configured, click below to download your complete index.html file with the current custom gallery list baked inside. For GitHub-synced images, keep the image files in the repository.
